purpose: Literature-supported onboarding annotations; not new qualification evidence or automatic function transfer.

cases.fold: Ferredoxin-like, SCOP d.58; shared superfamily d.58.1
cases.query: Gottschalkia acidurici FdxA (strain 9a; P00198; experimental reference 1FDN chain A)
cases.target: Allochromatium vinosum ferredoxin (strain D; P00208; experimental reference 1BLU chain A)
cases.function: Both are bacterial electron carriers with two [4Fe-4S] clusters. Experimental structures support a conserved cluster-binding core. This is a shared broad role within a homologous family.
cases.limit: Equal redox potential, electron-transfer rate and partner specificity are not established. The 1BLU study reports local structural differences and unusually slow transfer between its clusters. Displayed AlphaFold monomers lack the experimental iron-sulfur cofactors; the cited PDB structures document those cofactors.
cases.counterexample: The panel also pairs 1FDN/P00198 with acylphosphatase 1APS/P00818 (d.58.10): the same broad SCOP fold does not transfer electron-carrier function to an acyl-phosphate hydrolase. The recorded comparison is below the structural threshold, so SF-CSA reports unresolved_or_conflicted.

references.label: Moulis et al. 1996: 1BLU structure and mechanistic differences

cases.fold: OB-fold, SCOP b.40; shared superfamily b.40.4
cases.query: Bacillus subtilis CspB (strain 168; P32081; experimental reference 1CSP chain A)
cases.target: Escherichia coli CspA (strain K-12; P0A9X9; experimental reference 1MJC chain A)
cases.function: Both bind single-stranded nucleic acids in the cold-shock protein family. Sachs et al. measured B. subtilis CspB RNA binding in crystals and solution; Rennella et al. studied E. coli CspA RNA binding and RNA-remodelling kinetics by NMR. Together these support a shared RNA-binding role independently of structural similarity.
cases.limit: The two studies do not establish identical RNA targets, affinities, chaperone rates or regulatory effects. The CspB RNA-complex experiments use separate structures from the apo 1CSP reference. The displayed models contain no RNA, and the recorded sequence hit is not reciprocal-best-hit support.
cases.counterexample: The panel also pairs CspB with yeast inorganic pyrophosphatase 1E6A/P00817 (b.40.5). Sharing the broad OB-fold assignment does not imply shared RNA-binding function; the recorded SF-CSA comparison is below threshold and unresolved_or_conflicted.

references.label: Sachs et al. 2012: CspB RNA binding
Rennella et al. 2017: CspA RNA binding and chaperoning

functional_analogy.text: A different concept: in Anabaena, flavodoxin can replace ferredoxin as an electron carrier between photosystem I and ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase under iron limitation. These proteins have different structures and cofactors. This is functional substitution supported by experiments, not the meaning of the panel's fold_analogy label. It concerns a different ferredoxin system from the bacterial two-cluster pair above.
